title: H2 fails: filters trade less, they don't cut the tail
detail: Skipping 39 of 176 days (event days, inverted VIX term structure, big gaps) reduced losses roughly in proportion to days skipped: net -9.4%, CVaR(95) -0.77% vs -0.82% (6% better), worst day -0.83% vs -0.85% (2% better). The pre-registered gate needed 25% on both.
